021import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.Shop;
022import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.query.Filter;
023import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
024
025import java.util.UUID;
026
027/**
028 * WorldUUIDFilter
029 *
030 * @author creatorfromhell
031 * @since 6.3.0.0
032 */
033public class WorldUUIDFilter implements Filter<UUID> {
034
035  /**
036   * Determines whether the specified object satisfies the criteria defined by the implementation in
037   * the context of the given shop.
038   *
039   * @param shop   The shop to consider when evaluating the criteria.
040   * @param object The object to evaluate against the criteria.
041   *
042   * @return {@code true} if the object satisfies the criteria for the given shop, {@code false}
043   * otherwise.
044   */
045  @Override
046  public boolean applies(final @NotNull Shop shop, final @NotNull UUID object) {
047
048    return shop.bukkitLocation().isWorldLoaded() && shop.bukkitLocation().getWorld().getUID().equals(object);
049  }
050}
